newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Ministers to agree health monitoring programme.
newsitem.headline: Ministers to agree health monitoring programme.

text.p: European Union health ministers are expected on Thursday to agree quickly the setting up of an EU-wide health monitoring programme, EU diplomats said.
But they said it was uncertain if a compromise by the Dutch EU Presidency on an EU-network to monitor rabies and other contagious diseases would be agreed.
The European Commission says that the compromise waters down its proposals and does not allow the EU adequately to protect public health.

In 1996, the Commission proposed a compulsory system for sharing data on communicable diseases, notification and surveillance of selected diseases, consultation between member states on protective measures, especially at ports and airports.

But after some member states, notably Britain and Belgium, strongly resisted attempts to harmonise national rules, the Dutch Presidency suggested that it should be left to member states to decide how much information they would share.
